svg.title: Finance director — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as finance director, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: An open two-column budget ledger with a separate short stack of coins above the pages. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face.
